name: Doomed Shuttle
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World

stealth.note: (trained) to notice necromantic energy emanating from the cockpit (allowing the use of Arcana to Disable).

description: The planetary shuttle has already taken severe damage to its engines and hull, sending it on a crash course toward the planet. Meanwhile, a necromantic spell planted in the ship's computer will imminently unleash an explosion of void energy.
disable: DC 16 Piloting (trained) to take control and force the shuttle to a lower altitude, DC 18 Arcana (trained) or DC 18 Thievery (trained) to counter the necroblast long enough to prevent its detonation, DC 20 Perception to look for the closest landing zone, DC 20 Crafting (trained) to take apart the console and defuse the bomb, DC 23 Religion to pray for divine intercession; four total successes are required to defeat the hazard (see Development). A creature that succeeds at any of these checks gains a +1 circumstance bonus on their save against the hazard's damage for 1 round.
reset: The bomb goes off after 4 rounds. See Development.
routine: (3 actions) Void energy leaks out from the console as the necroblast prepares to detonate. All creatures on the ship take (2d6+4) Void Damage damage (Basic DC 18 Will Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Final Countdown
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The encounter begins

Effect The necroblast begins its detonation countdown, and the doomed shuttle rolls initiative.
